ops.text: 5.5 Ownership; Company Data. As between the Parties, the Company shall own all right, title and interest in and to the Site, including its design, look and feel, code and other deliverables and work product created by or for HDI under this Agreement, and HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest in and to such deliverables and work product. HDI shall retain ownership of its pre-existing intellectual property, and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any HDI intellectual property embedded in the deliverables. The Company retains all right, title and interest in and to all data collected from or about users and customers of the Site relating to Deerskin Products, including order and customer e-mail list data ("Company Data"). Nothing in this Agreement shall create any joint ownership of intellectual property.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement allocates no ownership of the Site, the deliverables and work product HDI creates for us, or the data generated through the Site, so we have added a short ownership section: we own and HDI assigns the deliverables and work product, HDI keeps its pre-existing IP and grants us a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any HDI IP embedded in the deliverables, we retain all rights in Company Data, and there is no joint ownership. If HDI prefers, we can instead work from our fallback under which HDI owns its generic tools and know-how and we take a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables for our business.
proposal.summary: Insert a preferred-level ownership clause: Company owns and HDI assigns deliverables and work product, HDI retains pre-existing IP with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any HDI IP embedded in the deliverables, Company retains all rights in Company Data, no joint ownership.
